exposure: modified biophysical profile with vibroacoustic stimulation test (VAST)
cohort: The study included 220 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies, gestational age more than 35 weeks, attending the labour room of obstetrics and gynecological department of Patna medical college and hospital.
finding: The addition of VAST to the modified biophysical profile significantly improved sensitivity (100% vs. 80%), specificity (92.5% vs. 75.2%), negative predictive value (100% vs. 98.7%), and test accuracy (92.7% vs. 75.4%) for predicting perinatal mortality compared to mBPP alone.
